cmd: echo '--git-credentials--'; cat ~/.git-credentials 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#://[^:]+:([^@]{0,10}).*(@github.com)#://<user>:\1...\2#'; echo '--bridge-token-file--'; sudo cat /etc/vps-github-bridge/token 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/(GITHUB_TOKEN=.{0,10}).*/\1.../'; echo '--env-GH_PAT--'; printenv GH_PAT 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/(.{0,10}).*/\1.../'; echo '--crontab-env--'; crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'GH_PAT\|GITHUB_TOKEN'
